problems: Cliopatria row Great Mongol State (1912-1925) is the Bogd Khanate of Mongolia, not the Yuan dynasty: its Wikipedia field and Wikidata Q7313 (shared with great-yuan and yuan-dynasty) are wrong for it; the dossier has wikidata null.

Cliopatria's Republic of China and Kuomintang rows do not contain Mongolia in 1912-1949 (checked by cell intersection), so the ledger's Chinese-rule events (loss November 1919, gains February-July 1921, Baitag Bogd 1947) need mirror events in the ea-08 dossiers, and the Republic of China should carry vassal_start/vassal_end for Outer Mongolia (1913/1915 to November 1919) and for the Three Districts (June 1946 to August 1947, if wanted).

East Turkestan Republic: the ETR page ends the state on 27 June 1946, Cliopatria and the Ili Rebellion page run it to 1949; the dossier follows Cliopatria (end December 1949) and a reviewer may prefer 1946.
Shared Wikidata Q840601 (East Turkestan 1463-1474 and East Turkestan Republic) are two different states; the existing east-turkestan dossier is left untouched.
Soviet client relations of the MPR (1921 onward) and of the ETR (1944-1945) belong in the union-of-soviet-socialist-republics dossier (eu-17) as vassal_start/vassal_end.
No tool failures; no rows split or merged; no new slugs written.
